title: Zesty Fluffy Moroccan Couscous Royal
description: A malty, fluffy brunch‑mood Moroccan dish with a subtle Thai fish sauce kick, steamed in a bain‑marie cauldron for airy perfection.
instructions: Bring water to a gentle simmer in a cauldron using the bain‑marie method.
Add couscous, stir, cover, and remove from heat; let steam for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in olive oil, cumin, ginger, salt, and fish sauce.
Fold in the diced carrot, zucchini, parsley, and lemon zest, mixing until vegetables are just coated.
Return the cauldron to low heat and stir gently for 2 minutes to warm the vegetables through.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or salt if desired.
Serve hot straight from the cauldron, garnished with extra parsley.
Allow the dish to cool slightly before serving to retain its airy texture.
